version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@uiw/react-back-top.svg?label=@uiw/react-back-top)](https://npmjs.com/@uiw/react-back-top)\n\n返回页面顶部的操作按钮。\n\n```jsx\nimport { BackTop } from 'uiw';\n// or\nimport BackTop from '@uiw/react-back-top';\n```\n\n## 基本用法\n\n```jsx mdx:preview\nimport React from 'react';\nimport { BackTop } from 'uiw';\n\nexport default function Demo() {\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <div>滚动滚动条，【快看右下角】，显示返回顶部按钮。</div>\n      <BackTop\n        style={{ backgroundColor: 'red', color: '#fff' }}\n        step={500}\n        speed={10}\n        content={<div>Top</div>}\n      />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## 函数子组件\n\n点击按钮滚动到顶部\n\n```jsx mdx:preview\nimport React from 'react';\nimport { BackTop, Button } from 'uiw';\n\nexport default function Demo() {\n  return (\n    <BackTop\n      fixed={false}\n      step={500}\n      clickable={false}\n      speed={10}\n    >\n      {({ percent, scrollToTop }) => (\n        <Button onClick={() => scrollToTop() } type=\"success\">点击滚动到顶部{`${percent}%`}</Button>\n      )}\n    </BackTop>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## 组件子节点\n\n点击按钮滚动到顶部\n\n```jsx mdx:preview\nimport React from 'react';\nimport { BackTop, Button } from 'uiw';\n\nexport default function Demo() {\n  return (\n    <BackTop\n      fixed={false}\n      step={500}\n      speed={10}\n    >\n      <Button type=\"success\">点击滚动到顶部</Button>\n    </BackTop>\n  )\n}\n```\n\n## Params\n\n| 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |\n|--------- |-------- |--------- |-------- |\n| content | 滚动到顶部按钮内容 | ReactNode/String | `0` |\n| offsetTop | 是否始终显示组件 | Number | `0` |\n| showBelow | 滚动距离多少时显示组件 | Number | `1` |\n| clickable | 是否可以点击 | Bool | `true` |\n| speed | 滚动速度 | Number | `50` |\n| fixed | 是否固定，默认`true` | Bool | `true` |\n| style | CSS样式 | Object | - |\n| className | CSS类名称 | String | - |\n| onClick | 点击回调 | Function | - |\n",
